document.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content:
IS 14543:2016
PACKAGED DRINKING WATER (OTHER THAN PACKAGED NATURAL MINERAL WATER) - SPECIFICATION
(Second Revision)
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for packaged drinking water (other than packaged natural mineral water) offered for sale in hermetically sealed containers of various descriptions.
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 1.2 Packaged drinking water shall be derived from surface water or underground water or potable water and treated using processes such as filtration, reverse osmosis, demineralization, and disinfection.
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 2.1 The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard.
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 3.1 Packaged Drinking Water - Water from any source which has been treated and packaged in hermetically sealed containers of various sizes, intended for direct consumption.
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 4.1 Hygienic Conditions: Packaged drinking water shall be prepared, processed, and packed under strict hygienic conditions in premises conforming to the guidelines in Annex B.
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 4.2 Physical and Chemical Requirements: The water shall be clear and free from undesirable odor, taste, and color. It shall conform to the chemical limits prescribed: pH value shall be between 6.5 and 8.5. Total dissolved solids (TDS) shall not exceed 500 mg/l.
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 4.3 Microbiological Requirements: The water shall be completely free from microorganisms like Escherichia coli, coliform bacteria, Salmonella, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa in 250 ml of sample.
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 4.4 Disinfection: Water shall be subjected to disinfection processes such as ozonation or UV irradiation to ensure microbiological safety before filling into containers.
chunks.document_title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification

chunks.content: 5.1 Packing: Packaged drinking water shall be filled in clean, hygienic, colorless, transparent, or food-grade tamper-proof containers conforming to IS 15410 or IS 12252.
